True amateur gearheads generally avoid automatic transmissions, claiming it takes away their control. The same goes for gun enthusiasts who think that modern pistols and rifles are too comfortable and convenient, not to mention target-tracing capabilities that mean any gonk can just pick up a gun and shoot on target. The solution for purists and analog-minded gun owners is the Liberty from Constitutional Arms. This pistol was created with one purpose in mind – to fire bullets. In the hands of an experienced shooter, it can be as lethal as the best Arasaka smartgun.

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 14 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Pistol Long Barrel, Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6).

Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Long Barrel, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
